feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Could a far left candidate win a midterm race in a red state like Florida?
entry.summary: Angie Nixon, the Democratic U.S. Senate Candidate in Florida, is running from the far left — raising questions about whether such a campaign can work in a red state like Florida.

entry.title: In 'Sophie, Standing There,' a fictional sound tech mics up (real) famous authors
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with writer Meg Mason about her latest book, Sophie, Standing There, and the one-sided relationships we form with some of our favorite authors.

entry.title: Tennessee's failed execution ignites a medical ethics debate
entry.summary: After a botched lethal injection in May, dozens of Tennessee medical professionals told the governor that healthcare professionals shouldn't help with executions, ever. No matter the method.

entry.title: AI has sparked anxiety, earlier generations showed us ways to manage our fears
entry.summary: Much of what we are hearing about AI leaves many people anxious about the risks posed by the technology. The writer Michael Sacacas takes a long view of how to manage such feelings.

entry.title: Chatbots are becoming a new reality for renters
entry.summary: Landlords are using AI chatbots to manage interactions with their tenants. We hear from one renter who just wants help from a human.

entry.title: The poverty rate among older Americans is rising, survey shows
entry.summary: Bucking the national trend, poverty has been steadily rising among seniors and older adults. A new survey sheds light on how low-income people are struggling in the crucial years before retirement.

entry.title: British men released on bail after suspected terror plot
entry.summary: Five British men have been released on bail after being detained near a military base for alleged terror offenses. The British base is used by the U.S. military for strikes on Iran.

entry.title: In new book, Princess Diana's brother remembers her as unforgettable
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Charles Spencer about his new book Swan Song.

entry.title: Gaming granny earns Guinness World Record
entry.summary: We speak with a grandma in Scotland who has earned a Guinness record for playing Fortnite.

entry.title: Remembering Mighty Sparrow, a calypso great who carried the genre into a new era
entry.summary: The legendary calypso singer Slinger Francisco, known popularly as Mighty Sparrow, has died at 91 years old.
